title: 21 Coffee Shop Marketing Ideas from an Expert | The Restaurant HQ

facts.fact: Per a Drive Research survey linked by the article, three out of four Americans drink at least one coffee a day.
facts.quote: In fact, [three out of four Americans](https://www.driveresearch.com/market-research-company-blog/coffee-survey/) drink at least one coffee a day.

facts.fact: The article cites Statista data stating that 98% of consumers use the internet to find new businesses.
facts.quote: With 98% of consumers [using the internet to find new businesses](https://www.statista.com/statistics/315709/online-local-business-search-frequency-us-canada/)

facts.fact: Squarespace (a vendor sponsoring the article) states it offers hundreds of website templates.
facts.quote: Choose from hundreds of templates and customize your design with AI for the perfect look.

facts.fact: The article was published on September 24, 2024.
The page says nearly 70% of consumers aged 18 to 49 use Instagram, citing Pew Research.
facts.quote: with nearly [70% of consumers 18 to 49]

facts.fact: According to Pew Research as cited on the page, 75% of 30- to 49-year-olds use Facebook.
facts.quote: Facebook is most popular, with 75% of 30- to 49-year-olds and 69% of 50- to 64-year-olds using the platform.

facts.fact: According to Pew Research as cited on the page, 69% of 50- to 64-year-olds use Facebook.
facts.quote: 69% of 50- to 64-year-olds using the platform

facts.fact: According to Pew Research as cited on the page, 53% of urban social media users are on Instagram.
facts.quote: a majority of urban customers (53%) on Instagram

facts.fact: According to Pew Research as cited on the page, 70% of rural social media users prefer Facebook.
facts.quote: more rural social media users (70%) prefer Facebook

facts.fact: The page recommends that coffee shops post on social media at least once per week, ideally one to two times per day.
facts.quote: at least once per week, but ideally, one to two times per day

facts.fact: A 2023 Swiftly study found that 82% of consumers report using coupons regularly.
facts.quote: a 2023 study by Swiftly found that 82% of consumers

facts.fact: The page states that Starbucks has sold more than 600 million pumpkin spice lattes since its introduction in 2003.
facts.quote: The company has sold [more than 600 million units]

facts.fact: First Branch Coffee in South Royalton, Vermont hosts an "Old-time Music" day on the second Sunday of every month.
facts.quote: hosts an “Old-time Music” day on the second Sunday of every month

facts.fact: The Restaurant HQ article states that more than 70% of consumers crave personalization from the brands they support, citing a McKinsey source.
facts.quote: More than [70% of consumers crave personalization](https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/growth-marketing-and-sales/our-insights/the-value-of-getting-personalization-right-or-wrong-is-multiplying) from the brands they support.

facts.fact: The article states that retaining a social media marketing agency will cost between $800 and $5,000 per month for a midsize coffee shop.
facts.quote: Retaining the services of a social media marketing agency will cost between $800 and $5,000 per month for a midsize coffee shop.

facts.fact: The article states that paid ads are an additional cost on top of agency fees, ranging from $500 to $1,500 per month.
facts.quote: Any paid ads would be an additional cost on top of the agency’s fees—from $500 to $1,500 per month.

facts.fact: Edible Magazine publishes regional, food-based magazines in dozens of US locations, according to the article.
facts.quote: Edible Magazine publishes regional, food-based magazines in dozens of US locations and frequently features coffee shops and roasters in its local coverage.

facts.fact: Geofencing works via GPS data, RFID tags, or Wi-Fi, according to the article.
facts.quote: Geofencing works via GPS data, RFID tags, or Wi-Fi.

facts.fact: The article describes a geofence as a virtual fence around a physical location that triggers an advertisement to a customer's smartphone when the customer enters the area.
facts.quote: A geofence is a virtual fence around a physical location.

facts.fact: The article states Starbucks is known for pinging nearby cell phones with happy hour offers during afternoon business lulls.
facts.quote: Starbucks is known for pinging nearby cell phones with happy hour offers during afternoon business lulls.

facts.fact: The article states a coffee subscription is especially suited to shops that roast their own beans.
facts.quote: A coffee subscription is especially suited to shops that roast their own beans.

facts.fact: The article describes a coffee of the month club where subscribers receive a pound of coffee beans.
facts.unit: pound of coffee beans per month
facts.quote: create a coffee of the month club, where subscribers receive a pound of coffee beans you’re excited about.

facts.fact: The article states that Instagram and Facebook are both owned by Meta, which allows advertisers to identify detailed customer profiles and set a budget for each ad.
facts.quote: Both platforms are owned by Meta, which allows you to identify detailed customer profiles to focus your advertising efforts and set a budget for each ad

facts.fact: Some coffee shop marketing options, such as posting on social media, only cost time, while others can run upwards of $1,500 or more per month.
facts.quote: Some marketing options—like posting on social media—only cost you time. Others can run you upwards of $1,500 or more per month.

facts.fact: Outdoor coffee shop signage can start at $250 for a sturdy wooden or PVC sign, rising to multiple thousands of dollars for custom-lit or neon signs.
facts.quote: Signs can run you from $250 for a sturdy wooden or PVC outdoor sign or up to multiple thousands of dollars for custom-lit or neon signs.

facts.fact: Coffee shop POS systems that do not include loyalty software at no charge may add a loyalty add-on fee of $25 to $50 per month.
facts.quote: Some include this for no additional charge, while others charge an add-on fee of $25 to $50 per month.

facts.fact: Hiring a freelance designer for coffee shop branding can cost between $250 and $5,000.
facts.quote: if you hire a freelance designer, you could spend $250 to $5,000.

facts.fact: Printing branded paper coffee cups runs around $150 per case of 1,000 cups.
facts.quote: Printing branded paper coffee cups and sleeves tends to run around $150 per case of 1,000 cups and $115 per case of 1,800 sleeves.

facts.fact: Most coffee shop POS systems that include email marketing tools charge an additional monthly fee of $25 or more.
facts.quote: Most coffee shop POS systems have some email marketing tools (though most charge an additional monthly fee of $25+).

facts.fact: Social media advertising can cost as little as $100 or as much as $3,000 or more per campaign.
facts.quote: as little as $100 or as much as $3,000+ per campaign.

facts.fact: Location-based social media geofencing ads cost a couple of hundred dollars per campaign, while a third-party geofencing company costs $10,000 or more.
facts.quote: Using a social media platform for location-based advertising will run you a couple of hundred dollars per campaign. Working with a third-party geofencing company will run you $10,000 or more.

facts.fact: Printing T-shirts for coffee shop merchandise can vary from $8 to $18 per shirt depending on design and order quantity.
facts.quote: printing T-shirts can vary from $8 to $18 per shirt depending on your design and the number of shirts you order

facts.fact: For a coffee shop subscription club, payment processing fees typically run from 3% to 5% of total price, and 5% to 6% if subscriptions are sold primarily online.
facts.quote: payment processing fees, which typically run from 3% to 5% of your total price. If you primarily sell your subscriptions online, your processing fees will be closer to the 5% to 6% range.

facts.fact: Customer preferences shift almost annually, according to the article, making coffee trends hard to keep up with.
facts.quote: Customer preferences shift almost annually, and it can be hard to keep up with all the coffee trends and personalized customer preferences.
